attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file South Carolina state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in SC (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "SC" streq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets SC economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "SC" streq and

action_details.action_description: SC filing required due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: "SC filing required due to physical presence. Reference: SC Code 12-6-2320" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_description: SC filing required due to economic nexus
action_details.action_postfix: "SC filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: SC Code 12-36-2691" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No SC nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate SC state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SC state additions and subtractions; Calculate SC-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "SC income adjustments calculated. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1130 (additions), 12-6-1140 (subtractions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No SC nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No SC nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate SC state corporate income tax. Applies SC 5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Also includes SC annual license fee.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SC tax at 5% flat rate; SC income tax at 5% plus license fee
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.license_fee_minimum get /license_fee xdef apportionment.state_tax get license_fee get add /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "SC tax calculated at 5% flat rate plus license fee ($15 minimum). Reference: SC Code 12-6-530, 12-20-50" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No SC nexus - no tax liability; No SC nexus - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income - license fee only; No SC taxable income but license fee applies
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.license_fee_minimum get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No SC taxable income - license fee only ($15 minimum). NOL carryforward 15 years. Reference: SC Code 12-6-1500, 12-20-50" job.audit_trail swap addto
